enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing. Turning to left side. Pulling blanket up. Turning to right side. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Sleeping. Waking briefly. Turning over. Sleeping again.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Lather. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone for the day's program schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Scroll through schedule. Close calendar. Put phone in pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community center
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to front door. Open door. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to community center. Open door. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: coordinating volunteers, running program logistics, meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Type reply. Pick up phone. Call volunteer. Talk on phone. Hang up. Pick up notebook. Walk to meeting room. Sit in meeting. Discuss program logistics. Take notes with pen. Return to desk. Open program document. Type notes. Greet colleague with 'Good morning'.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of office. Walk to café. Open café door. Walk to counter. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive sandwich. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk back to office. Open office door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community program planning, partner outreach, and reporting
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open program planning document. Type notes. Pick up phone. Call partner organization. Talk on phone. Write down contact info. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Create report. Print report. Pick up report. Walk to manager's office. Hand report to manager. Return to desk. Open email. Reply to email.

Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Open front door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat with fork. Drink water. Stand up. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check message. Put down phone. Watch TV. Laugh. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing program notes and replying to emails on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Enter password. Open email program. Read emails. Type reply. Send email. Open program notes document. Read notes. Make edits. Save document. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

Walk to bathroom. Close door. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Hang towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the fan on and browsing the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like post. Close app. Open another app. Scroll. Put down phone. Turn off phone. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing. Turning to left side. Pulling blanket. Turning to right side. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Sleeping. Waking briefly. Turning over. Sleeping again.
